title: Raise conditional staged544 κ by filling idle owner slots
body:
## Result

Construct a staged544 terminal-gap supplier with conditional κ

`0.001730663236534549309146 − 10^-46 − 10^-70`.

This improves the PR3734/3815/3875 construction by more than `8.4799268302490405 × 10^-8`. Enlarge 26 protected helper terminals from width 4 to width 5 and refit scalar/native frames jointly. Each affected rank-32 owner bin changes from `4 + 9 + 9 + 9 + 1 idle` to `5 + 9 + 9 + 9`, removing exactly 84,240 idle rank-1 cells. Every owner, time, child and port is retained; offsets are regenerated explicitly.

The complete paid profile is `{1:8041680,2:2306880,3:729648,4:353160,5:69120,8:25920,48:137952}` on T360. The inherited release retains its original PR3682 comparison; a separate rational certificate proves the stronger comparison against the PR3815 profile underlying PR3875. An elementary sufficient theorem proves strict moment improvement for every `0 < κ ≤ 0.002`; exact rational signs isolate the new root to one unit in the 24th decimal place. This is a changed construction, not just tighter numerical evaluation.

## Evidence and reproduction

Both exact included gzip words passed fresh complete five-stage native replay, including all-column warp recipes and original rejecting controls. Independent implementations check both complete arbitrary-dirty forward/dual/cleanup-boundary operators, frame/transport charges, all 1,321,920 literal owner roles in 725,760 bins, and the exact moment. Normal and optimized controls reject source, frame, chronology, family, offset, capacity and price mutations.

The portable default replay is standard-library Python 3.12. It freshly recomputes local semantics, frames, owners and rational prices; native and whole-chain receipts are authenticated separately. The optional full replayer downloads one immutable SHA-256-pinned public predecessor archive, checks all 756 members, reconstructs the exact source delta and runs fresh native/global/outer stages. The 33 MB dependency archive is not added to the branch. Every historical source/receipt reuse and six source-file modifications plus six additions are disclosed. The initial 666-file source closure and the generated 670-file release package are distinguished; exact runtime-patch hash chains, repaired cache-header inventories and completed-checkpoint reuse are retained. A second closure-only repair replaces legacy 139-control summaries with the frozen specification's derived 119: eliminating width 4 removes exactly 20 inapplicable distinct-width-pair mutations. All 119 actual mutations reject. Fresh scientific-stage outputs are hash sealed; authenticated source tails resume final closure and remaining controls. Original failed attempts and the exact continuation are retained. No generated scientific mutation or admission predicate is removed.

## Scope and overlap

Only `research/staged544-terminal-gap-fill/` changes. Canonical base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6, was refreshed unchanged at entry, pivots and publication. Explicit assigned κ task, narrowed to one complete sufficient supplier. The previous round retained 608 open PR bodies; latest updated all-state bodies were refreshed through PR3941. Discussion reading was bounded, not complete pagination. PR3933's actual fixed-terminal entrance audit is distinct. The actual PR3934 README/verifier uses a different T740 rank-7 route and extra hosted-receiver hypothesis; it advertises a higher draft endpoint with native/controller/outer gates unrun. PR3936 supplies a completed T385 wrapper and separate R437 COPY audit; it does not remove inherited all-size/caller premises here. PR3939's actual README adds higher conditional R438 pooling with a native-emission gap. PR3941's actual README/proof fixes terminal exits in two neutral-first retiming domains and does not cover this changed inventory; credit Chris R / Clear1nsight, PR3886/3734, Jeremy Kothe PR2957/2979 and Dugongue PR3863/MathProof lineage. No global best-known κ or exhaustive novelty claim is made here.

The shared DAG's coordinated character/hyperplane cuts and the prior transported-frame representation were reused. The new coupling is terminal dimension with the rent of a real owner gap, followed by an attained literal certificate. Solver output was nomination only. Failed bounded contraction, gauge, staging and graph experiments are retained privately, not counted as discoveries.

The endpoint remains conditional on inherited universal/all-size source, hosting, precision/tape/recovery, analytic and BIT premises. Selected frontier, existing scientific engines, frozen predecessor inputs and other PRs are unchanged. No Lean/kernel or independent human review is claimed.

## Open next question

Seek another explicit end-frame extension that fits an actual idle coordinate. First freeze the literal schedule and emit a complete local word; recompute native, invoice and outer checks before claiming another κ gain. Relaxed packing alone is not sufficient.
